entities.name: Caverns of Despair
entities.description: Cave system under Arboria in Jamuraa on Dominaria, used by Shauku as a prison for a Cosmic Horror.

entities.name: Arboria
entities.description: Region of Jamuraa above the caverns.

entities.name: Shauku
entities.description: Vampire who enslaved the Cosmic Horror beneath her ruined castle.

entities.name: Cosmic Horror
entities.description: Organic creature fallen from the stars that built the hexagonal tunnels and was enslaved by Shauku.

entities.name: Floral Spuzzem
entities.description: Lethal creatures wandering the caverns, formed by eating crystal nectar.

entities.name: Crimson Kobolds
entities.description: Loyal but unintelligent guards of the caverns.

entities.name: Falling Star
entities.description: Star impact that formed the caverns.

entities.name: Jedit Ojanen
entities.description: Member of the party that freed the Cosmic Horror.

entities.name: Adira Strongheart
entities.description: Member of the party that freed the Cosmic Horror.

entities.name: Jasmine Boreal
entities.description: Member of the party that freed the Cosmic Horror.

events.summary: A Falling Star impacts southern Arboria, forming the caverns around the Cosmic Horror.
events.quote: The Caverns of Despair formed in ancient times when a Falling Star impacted in southern Arboria

events.summary: Shauku discovers and enslaves the Cosmic Horror.
events.quote: She enslaved the creature and put Aron Legionnaires and kobolds into service guarding it.

events.summary: A party of Jedit, Adira, Jasmine and the Circle of Seven frees the Cosmic Horror, which summons a Falling Star to annihilate the caverns; Shauku secretly escapes.
events.quote: They freed the Cosmic Horror, which summoned another Falling Star to annihilate the caverns

relations.note: Put into service guarding the horror.
relations.quote: She enslaved the creature and put Aron Legionnaires and kobolds into service guarding it.
The Caverns of Despair were a system of caves and tunnels underneath Arboria
